jobs.title: Java FSD - ONLY W2 - Independent candidates only can apply
jobs.description:
**JAVA FSD**

**NYC, NY/ Jersey City, NJ/ Willmington, DE/ Columbus, OH \- Onsite**

**Contract \- W2**

**Job Description**Java FSD (Full Stack Developer) designs, builds, and maintains complete web applications using Java for the backend and modern JavaScript frameworks for the frontend. Key Responsibilities

* **Backend Development:** Build secure server\-side logic, RESTful APIs, and microservices using Java and Spring Boot.
* **Frontend Development:** Create responsive user interfaces using modern frameworks like React.js or Angular.
* **Database Management:** Design, query, and optimize relational databases (like MySQL, Oracle, or PostgreSQL).
* **Testing \& Quality:** Write unit and integration tests following Test\-Driven Development (TDD).
* **Collaboration:** Work in Agile teams using version control tools like Git and CI/CD deployment pipelines.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* **Core Skills:** Strong proficiency in Core and Advanced Java (OOPs, Collections, Streams).
* **Frameworks:** Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate / JPA.
* **Frontend:** JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and React.js or Angular.
* **Databases \& Cloud:** SQL, plus exposure to AWS, Docker, or Kubernetes.
* **Experience:** Typically ranges from 3 to 10\+ years depending on mid\-level or lead roles.

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Senior Full Stack Developer

**Job Location:** Remote

**Job Type:** W2 Contract

**Duration:** 12\+ Months

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to design, develop, deploy, and support scalable web applications and backend services. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with modern front\-end and back\-end technologies, RESTful APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and DevOps practices.

The selected candidate will work closely with developers, data engineers, DevOps teams, and product owners to deliver secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, deploy, and support full stack web applications in a production environment.
* Build and optimize responsive user interfaces and backend APIs and services.
* Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and backend systems.
* Ensure secure and reliable integration between frontend, backend, and analytics services.
* Implement authentication, authorization, and data protection across the application stack.
* Develop reusable code, UI components, and API endpoints to support scalable solutions.
* Integrate web applications with analytics platforms and services.
* Participate in code reviews and maintain technical documentation.
* Support application deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with developers, data engineers, DevOps teams, and product owners throughout the development lifecycle.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience building, deploying, and supporting full stack web applications in a production environment.
* Strong experience developing and integrating RESTful APIs and backend systems.
* Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6\+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3\.
* Experience developing responsive and user\-friendly web interfaces.
* Strong experience with at least one modern front\-end framework such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Proficiency in one or more backend technologies,
